procedure: The reviewer labeled all anonymized records before opening author labels or source mapping, then reconciled. Initial and final positions remain available. No evaluated model outputs were supplied during label review.
threshold_clarification: The fixed continuous threshold is h < 1. An ordinal or modal grade of 1 does not uniquely locate the probability-weighted scalar relative to that threshold; initial rationale wording about an unspecified threshold should be read as insufficient evidence about h, not an unknown threshold.
